panels.title: Active problems by severity
panels.description: Triggers in problem state across the selected regions (includes hosts in maintenance).

panels.title: Hosts with active maintenance
panels.description: Monitored hosts in an active Zabbix maintenance, including maintenances scoped to specific problem tags (e.g. container=fluentd).

targets.root_selector: (result.{"Host": name, "Host group": (groups[$contains(name, /^os\/[a-z-]+[0-9]+$/)].name)[0], "In maintenance since": $number(maintenance_from) * 1000})[`Host group` in ${Group:json}]

panels.title: Problems per rack
panels.description: Active, non-suppressed problems grouped by the host rack tag. Problems without a rack tag are not listed.
